fusions.name: Sawgrass Ring
fusions.desc: Whips razor-edged grass around you, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Pruning Cut
fusions.desc: A clean cut at one enemy at or below 25% health (the threshold rises with rank) that deals 24 damage and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.2 times their remaining damage. You have 50% more critical chance against a target that has not yet bled.

fusions.name: Undergrowth Lurk
fusions.desc: Veils you in leaves for 6 seconds, moving 10% faster; enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack. You restore 8 health.

fusions.name: Thorn in the Wound
fusions.desc: You deal 10% more damage to enemies carrying an affliction.
